# Test data (synthetic, non-confidential)

Everything in this folder is invented for development and testing (requirement R3).
"Brightwater Labs", the "Tidewatch API" and the "Kelp-3 buoy" are fictional.
It is safe to send this content to the public OpenAI API.

* `handbook/`  – engineering handbook (Markdown)
* `api_docs/`  – product API documentation (Markdown + HTML)
* `reports/`   – field trial report (PDF) and architecture review (DOCX),
                 generated by `python testdata/make_testdata.py`
